claims.text: the car pulls forward out of the dark
The source clip shows a car rolling through a tunnel and crossing frame left to right.
The tunnel has gritty tarmac, soft reflections along the car bodywork, and a faint echo.

json.soundscape: Low engine idle deepening into a steady rumble, tyres rolling over gritty tarmac, and a faint tunnel echo trailing the car.

description.text: In near-blackness, the car sits low in frame inside a tunnel, its body only just separated from the shadowed walls. A slow forward creep begins as the car pulls against the dark, the space ahead still compressed and unreadable. Dim wall texture slides past at the edges while the car holds the center of the frame, low and heavy. The light remains thin and cool, with no clean source visible, so the shape of the car is picked out mainly by soft reflections along its bodywork. A small, slow push in keeps the composition tight and expectant, letting the darkness feel physical rather than empty.
Dim tunnel walls press close around the car, with only a thin slick of light along the bodywork.
Low engine idle and a faint tunnel echo.

The forward roll becomes sustained. The car gathers speed and tracks through the tunnel, its nose lifting slightly as the body moves clear of the deepest shadow. The wall texture becomes readable in the weak light, and the car's silhouette stays steady against the curved passage. Grit and road surface give the movement a tactile, rolling rhythm; the frame follows with a small, slow track, keeping the car at a constant scale while the background slides past. The dark recedes gradually rather than breaking at once, so the change is a measured emergence into a slightly brighter stretch of tunnel.
The car rolls forward, gathers speed, and tracks through the tunnel as the gloom begins to recede.
Engine note rises, tyres roll over gritty tarmac, and the tunnel echo lengthens.

The final push brings the car fully clear of the deep shadow, its shape brightening as the surrounding tunnel opens into a lighter stretch. The car continues forward with the same steady momentum, the body catching more light along its edges while the last of the gloom falls behind. The camera pushes in with a small, slow move, tightening on the car as it pulls ahead, and the tunnel walls lose detail at the frame edges. The motion resolves on the car advancing into the light, with no reversal or stop, and the sound of the engine and tyres carrying through to the cut.
The car pulls fully clear of the deep shadow into a lighter stretch of tunnel, still moving forward.
Engine under load and air rushing past the bodywork carry through the final advance.
